title: "Q&A Dataset Construction"
execute:

This chapter constructs the evaluation dataset used across all RAG configurations. We select representative passages from the AI Media Dataset, generate Q&A pairs using GPT-4o, categorise them by type, and manually review them for quality.

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: imports
#| code-summary: "Show imports"

import json
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from tqdm import tqdm
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser

load_dotenv()
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

REPO_ROOT = Path.cwd() if (Path.cwd() / "data").exists() else Path.cwd().parents[1]
STAGE1_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed"
STAGE3_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "stage3"
STAGE3_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# OpenAI models - analog Cleantech tutorial
LLM_MODEL   = "gpt-4o"        # Q&A generation
JUDGE_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"   # cheaper, for RAGAS later
```
